01 / Everyday records

Keep the day-to-day numbers in order.

Bookkeeping is easier to use when it is kept current. Clarentis supports bank and card reconciliation, purchase and sales records, aged payables, invoicing and year-end adjustments.

  • Know what has been paid and what is still due.
  • Keep records ready for returns and year end.
  • Make decisions from organised numbers.

02 / Returns and deadlines

Know what needs filing and when.

Tax work varies with your business. Clarentis can help prepare returns, keep records ready and plan around filing dates.

Self-Assessment

Personal tax returns for sole traders, directors, shareholders and people with untaxed income.

VAT

Registration review, MTD-ready records, return preparation, submission support and deadline tracking.

Corporation Tax

Computation and return support, with planning around liabilities and filing deadlines.

03 / Getting established

Support from setup to staff payments.

Choose the work your business needs now. Clarentis can discuss the practical setup as well as ongoing tasks in your initial consultation.

Company registration

Company formation support, Companies House registration guidance and first-step tax and accounting setup.

PAYE and payroll

PAYE setup, payslips, RTI submissions, starters and leavers, P60s/P45s and auto-enrolment pension filings.

Common questions

The details worth knowing.

Who is Clarentis for?

Clarentis works with UK startups, sole traders and small limited companies.

What affects the final quote?

The services in scope, transaction volume and complexity. The fee guide is indicative; Clarentis reviews your needs before agreeing a fixed fee.

Can Clarentis help a new company get started?

Yes. The published service list includes company formation support, Companies House guidance and initial tax and accounting setup.

What should I include in my email?

Tell Clarentis whether you are a startup, sole trader or limited company, what support you need, and any current records or deadlines to discuss at the free initial consultation.
